newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan crown prince to visit U.S. on aid mission.
newsitem.headline: Jordan crown prince to visit U.S. on aid mission.

text.p: Jordan's Crown Prince Hassan is due in Washington next Monday to hold talks with U.S. President Bill Clinton on boosting aid to the kingdom, officials said on Tuesday.
Jordan has requested from Washington a substantial increase in aid. King Hussein last week sent a letter to Clinton on his country's economic needs, Jordanian officials said.
Last month the U.S. State Department said it was seeking ways to increase aid.
Amman has won debt forgiveness and military aid from Washington worth almost one billion dollars as a reward for signing its 1994 peace treaty with Israel.
